purpose: Single-glance status of every KnowledgeStore backend candidate evaluated for UETGPT. Detail lives in each candidate's own subdirectory; this file is an index, not a substitute.
guiding_question: What is now the simplest, safest, sustainable $0 retrieval architecture for UETGPT?

fixed_project_facts.retrieval: hybrid dense + lexical, application-level RRF, reranking, citations, freshness logic
fixed_project_facts.budget: $0 recurring infrastructure cost unless the user explicitly changes it

candidates.name: Convex (@convex-dev/rag)
candidates.status: PRODUCTION - unchanged and untouched by this entire evaluation
candidates.note: Remains the default (KNOWLEDGE_STORE_BACKEND=convex) throughout. No candidate evaluation replaces it until an explicit, evidence-backed production cutover decision is made - none has been made.

candidates.name: Turso Cloud / libSQL (DiskANN)
candidates.verdict_summary: Tested DiskANN configurations failed the required combination of retrieval quality, build behavior, and operational recoverability.
candidates.key_evidence: Recall@10=0.963 at 10,000-row scale (below the 0.98 gate); index build did not complete at the full 20,652-row production scale in either compression mode tested within a 30-minute client timeout.

candidates.name: Zilliz Cloud Free (Milvus)
candidates.role: candidate #2 (fallback after Turso rejection, per pre-existing mandate section 33)
candidates.verdict_summary: Hard gate: operational availability under realistic inactivity. Functional KnowledgeStore contract suite passed 9/10 (the 1 failure is a documented structural limitation - no native compare-and-swap - not a general defect).
candidates.key_evidence: Free-tier clusters auto-suspend after 7 (or, per a second same-source quote, 14) days of inactivity, requiring an explicit resume action; no synthetic keep-warm traffic is permitted as a workaround.

candidates.name: Pinecone Starter (serverless, OnDemand)
candidates.role: candidate #3 (fallback after both Turso and Zilliz rejected, per pre-existing mandate section 34) - NOT pre-approved
candidates.status: RESEARCH COMPLETE, HARD GATE PASSED - implementation and benchmarking not yet started
candidates.verdict_summary: No verdict yet. Idle-lifecycle hard gate (the specific reason Zilliz failed) is PASSED: no auto-suspend/archive/delete-on-inactivity policy found on current Starter/serverless docs, unlike Zilliz. This clears the way to proceed, but does not itself constitute a pass on any other gate (dense ANN recall, lexical parity, lifecycle/concurrency correctness, storage/usage headroom, real retrieval baseline) - all remain to be executed.
candidates.blocking_status: Implementation is BLOCKED pending user-supplied PINECONE_API_KEY (absent from .env.local as of last check). Research and evidence-organization work is not blocked by this and has proceeded.

architectures_to_evaluate_independently.description: Convex application state + Pinecone dense + Pinecone sparse, combined via UETGPT's existing RRF + reranker + citations. The main fully-external candidate.

Convex application state + minimal canonical/lexical corpus (corrected footprint, not the historically bloated multi-representation state) + Pinecone dense vectors only, combined via existing RRF. Explicitly flagged as potentially 'the simplest and safest UETGPT design' if the minimal Convex footprint measures out comfortably - must be measured, not assumed.

Pinecone document-schema/BM25 index. Research-only per current findings: the integrated full-text API is still Public Preview (2026-01.alpha) with no Node/TypeScript SDK. Not a production candidate unless the user explicitly accepts alpha-API risk.

self_hosted_fallback_note: Per acceptance-gates.json section 35: if no managed $0 service satisfies the required lifecycle and capacity, a self-hosted Qdrant (knowledge corpus) + Convex (app state) split may be evaluated, but only if a reliable, already-available $0 hosting machine exists - a VPS must never be assumed free. This has not been triggered and is not under evaluation while Pinecone remains untested.
decision_discipline: Do not reopen Turso or Zilliz unless new evidence proves the prior test itself was invalid. Do not jump to a candidate #4 (Upstash, self-hosted, etc.) if Pinecone fails - that requires a fresh, explicit decision. Pinecone must pass or fail on its own merits, evaluated against the same acceptance gates as every other candidate.
